title: When the Ghost Sings
author: M. M. Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Hartwell, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
